info.title: homeserver
info.description: The REST API of a homeserver node. Every request carries a token: `Authorization: Bearer …`, the password of HTTP Basic, or the session cookie set by `POST /api/session`. Errors are `{"error": "…"}`.

post.summary: Store bytes by their hash. A resource refers to them by `hash`.

get.summary: Stored bytes, or a thumbnail of an image. Supports `Range`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The media type to send it as (never one that runs script).

parameters.name: thumb
parameters.description: A thumbnail this many pixels on its longer side instead (16 to 1024).

416.description: The range is outside the blob

get.summary:
Changes as they happen, as Server-Sent Events. Each `data:` line is an
`Event`; `id:` is its sequence number.
Everything the node keeps, as a tar archive. Owner only.
The grants that are not revoked. Owner only.

delete.summary: Revoke a grant; its token stops working. Owner only.

get.summary:
A resource's payload, with its `ETag`. Contacts and events stored as
JSON can be had as vCard or iCalendar.

parameters.name: space
parameters.description: A space's name, ID or unique ID prefix

parameters.name: format
parameters.description:
`vcard` or `ical`, for contacts and events stored as JSON (also by
`Accept`).

put.summary:
Store a resource: JSON, vCard or iCalendar (kept as JSON), or any other
bytes as they are.

parameters.name: space
parameters.description: A space's name, ID or unique ID prefix

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Only if the current ETag matches

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: `*`: only if it does not exist yet

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retries with the same key are applied once

Error.description: Every error: a message for people.

Grant.description: A grant: what a token may do. The token itself is never shown again.

session.description: Whether it is a sign-in session (from a passkey or an app).

spaces.description: The spaces it is limited to (hex); none means all.

types.description: The types it is limited to; none means all.

Handover.description: Hand the primary role to another member.

Join.description:
Join a space kept by another node, which must already have added this
node as a member.

Listing.description: Rows as lists answer: a bare array, or a `Page` with `page=1`.

Member.description: A member of a space: a node, the identity it acts for, and a role.

session.description: Mark it as a sign-in session, revoked on sign-out.

spaces.description: Limit it to these spaces (names or IDs).

NewMember.description:
Add a member: a node by key and identity, or by `url`, which is asked
for both.

home.description: Where the node is reachable, if not at `url`.

url.description: The node's URL, to look up its key and identity.

info.description: Anything else to say about it.

token.description: The bearer token, shown only this once.

NodeInfo.description:
What a node says about itself, publicly (also at
`/.well-known/homeserver`).

did.description: The owner's identity as a DID.

url.description: Where it is reachable, if set.

next_offset.description: The `offset` of the next page, if there is one.

Pulled.description: Changes fetched from a space's primary.

Related.description: A row and how it relates to the one asked about.

rel.description: The relation, as named in the payload that links them.

Role.description: What a role allows in a space.

Row.description: A resource as lists, search and the timeline show it.

body.description: The payload, if it is JSON.

payload.description: The payload hash (hex); null if erased.

seq.description: The sequence number of its last change.

time.description: The time it is about: its own `time` field, or `updated`.

Session.description: Who is asking: a grant's token, another node, or nobody (`role` null).

grant.description: The grant's ID, for a token.

node.description: The key ID, for another node.

owner.description: Whether the token is the owner's.

oneOf.description: The grant's role, for a token; null for nobody.

roles.description: Another node's roles in spaces it shares with this one.

spaces.description: The spaces a token is limited to (hex); none means all.

types.description: The types a token is limited to; none means all.

SignIn.description: Sign in with a token; the answer also sets the session cookie.

home.description: Where the primary is reachable, if this node is not it.

info.description: What else its creator said about it.

primary.description: The node that orders its changes (key ID).

seq.description: How many changes it has had.
